## Overview

This is another week with a single lecture, because Monday is Labor Day.
It will be the first of two weeks focused on the Unix shell,
which is a powerful command-line interface that
we'll be using extensively throughout the course.

## Learning goals & lectures

#### A) [**Unix shell basics**](./w3a_shell-basics.qmd) _(Wednesday)_

- What the Unix shell is and what you can do with it.
- Why it can be beneficial to use a command-line interface in general,
  and the Unix shell specifically.
- How Unix commands are structured.
- How to navigate around your computer with Unix commands.
